verdict.rationale: Fellow explicitly documents botless capture: 'record with a visible bot or without one — capturing audio directly from the desktop' across Zoom, Meet, Teams, Slack Huddles and in-person meetings, which directly matches the founder story of no visible bot joining while still transcribing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that no bot artifact appears to external participants, and detail on how desktop-audio capture technically avoids detection.
